verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public GitHub repository for Lium's official CLI (Datura-ai/lium) and a public lium-skill repo, so some client-side source appears readable. Nothing in the pack states an open-source license, and the platform/server source is never shown to be public. missing for 10: any stated open license (e.g. MIT/Apache), evidence that the core platform source is published, independent confirmation that the repo contains full readable source rather than just a README.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
